mentions.name: datapages
mentions.description: A Datastar metaframework for Go, built as a CLI toolchain with a code generator and linter for server-rendered web apps using the Datastar + Templ + Go stack. Approaching beta stage with v0.10.0.
mentions.problem: JavaScript-based SSR is wasteful, and the author wanted tools that make Go SSR projects quick to start and easier to maintain, especially when working with coding agents.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A Datastar metaframework for Go: https://github.com/romshark/datapages

it's a CLI toolchain with a code generator and linter.
mentions.author: romshark
